dedupe_keys.name: honda smart home davis 2020 benchmark observations

description: The Honda Smart Home benchmark release provides raw and curated observations from a demonstration residence in Davis, California. The DOE Benchmark Datasets for Buildings programme publishes CSV data covering 1 January through 31 December 2020. Listed categories include energy use, equipment operation, onsite generation, indoor and outdoor conditions, control settings, occupancy, asset attributes and design information. Building metadata describe a two-storey single-family house with a detached garage and 1,944 square feet of floor area; the listed HVAC system is a radiant geothermal heat pump. The inspected public metadata do not specify a sampling interval or a complete measurement-channel dictionary. The current provider catalogue assigns CC0, and the linked licence page confirms the public-domain dedication. Downloading or browsing the files requires sign-in, although the descriptive metadata are public and no sign-in was needed for this review. Single-house coverage limits generalisation to ordinary housing stock, and the demonstration objective does not establish measured zero-carbon performance. Simulation uses include integrated building-energy calibration and testing control assumptions. No catalogue record for this specific 2020 release was found. The curated list’s one-minute interval, channel counts and CC BY claim were not adopted without matching current provider evidence.
